bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to natural resources; providing for grants to restore and create wetlands for the wetland banking program; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. GRANTS TO RESTORE AND CREATE WETLANDS; APPROPRIATION.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Water and Soil Resources for a cost-sharing program that provides assistance to landowners for restoring and creating sustainable wetlands that are eligible for wetland banking under the Wetland Conservation Act under Minnesota Statutes, sections 103G.222 and 103G.2251. The following activities are eligible for grants:

(1) site assessment and evaluation;

(2) engineering design and construction, including rerouting or removing drainage systems;

(3) establishing vegetation; and

(4) costs associated with establishing long-term easements on the wetland.
additions: GRANTS TO RESTORE AND CREATE WETLANDS; APPROPRIATION.
